hypotheses.claim: Query/compute fusion and storage/index fusion are orthogonal: one planner can execute a fused cross-modal subplan while selected payload/index structures remain physically decoupled.
hypotheses.why_transformed: PostgreSQL-V/DecoupleVS provide counterevidence to naive integrated-storage assumptions while AkasicDB provides counterevidence to naive polystore assumptions.
hypotheses.next_test: real FRANK cross-modal trace on fused-compute x storage/index placement factorial

hypotheses.claim: The correct physical design object is a PlacementVector/lattice rather than one per-store colocation label.
hypotheses.why_transformed: U1's four labels cannot express decoupled index + fused compute + shared transaction manager + separate fault domain combinations.
hypotheses.next_test: compare prediction/rollback quality of binary labels vs placement vectors on target traces

hypotheses.claim: Result admissibility is independent of provenance: a perfectly provenance-bound ANN or activation result remains a candidate/prior rather than an exact fact.
hypotheses.why_transformed: Selection-integrity and CACC evidence show authentic ancestry does not establish relevance, exactness or downstream authority.

hypotheses.claim: Replay integrity and selection integrity require separate receipts and tests.
hypotheses.why_transformed: U2 recovery tests and structural-selection calibration both succeeded under different controls; either property can hold without the other.
hypotheses.next_test: cross replay-valid/invalid with selector-valid/invalid in one live ClayGraph corpus

hypotheses.claim: Typed semantic equality and exact emitted representation identity must remain separate across every serialization/IPC adapter.
hypotheses.why_transformed: The initial U2 comparator falsely reported semantic mismatch solely because JSON changed tuple to list; explicit ORDERED semantics recovered 10000/10000 semantic matches.

hypotheses.claim: Replay identity is event history plus derivation-program/schema/model version, not event history alone.
hypotheses.why_transformed: Living Databases and UnifiedDB derived-view evolution imply multiple valid projections can arise from one history under changed transformation semantics.
hypotheses.next_test: versioned derivation rebuild with exact expected historical/current projections

hypotheses.claim: Consistency should be operation-adaptive: critical exact reads can require zero lag while exploratory association can admit bounded declared lag when closure is known.
hypotheses.why_transformed: U2 synthetic admission calibration shows the availability cost of a universal exact barrier; G12 shows narrow scope is unsafe when closure is unknown.
hypotheses.next_test: trace-derived lag budgets with known-vs-unknown closure

hypotheses.claim: CACC utility adaptation should consume durable outcome/evaluation receipts through UnifiedDB but only update salience/routing policies, preserving canonical fact identity.
hypotheses.why_transformed: Hypofusion H1 adds anti-attractor risk; U2 now gives utility receipts a separate derived role and placement.
hypotheses.next_test: anti-attractor salience learning with frozen canonical truth

hypotheses.claim: GWT R5 nested-workspace experiments require upstream database query/collection/search-space receipts to identify whether candidate formation or workspace uptake caused the effect.
hypotheses.why_transformed: U2 collection/selection evidence shows candidate topology can change materially before either workspace level.
hypotheses.next_test: nested-Qwen factorial with candidate formation pinned and receipted

hypotheses.claim: Physical plan identity is scientifically causal when approximate, ordering, truncation, freshness or selection behavior can differ; for proven exact-equivalent routes it may remain audit/performance identity rather than semantic identity.
hypotheses.why_transformed: Graphiti/equivalence work plus U2 boundary results sharpen when a physical-plan hash is epistemically relevant.

hypotheses.claim: Android should reuse CPPF semantic/query contracts while choosing a device-specific placement vector rather than cloning Linux engines/processes.
hypotheses.why_transformed: U2 separates semantics from physical placement and H1 emphasizes sustained resource governance on edge devices.
hypotheses.next_test: Linux/Android differential replay plus sustained energy/thermal benchmark

hypotheses.claim: The likely production endpoint is selective physical fusion of hot subplans/transaction groups, not universal monolith or universal service separation.
hypotheses.why_transformed: External systems and U2 measurements show both fusion and decoupling have real regimes; the binary debate is underspecified.
hypotheses.next_test: trace-driven optimizer with reversible selective placement changes
